input.summary: Replace Section 6.1 exclusivity with a non-exclusive provider statement; no sole-provider obligation on the Company.
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Section 6.1, which barred us from any similar internet project for Deerskin or similar products for the whole (auto-renewing) term and gave HDI the exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand, with a non-exclusivity statement. Our position is no exclusivity or sole-provider obligation on us; if HDI needs something here, we could consider exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products for a single 12-month period ending automatically on any service level or delivery date failure.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: 6.1 HDI shall be a non-exclusive provider of the services under this Agreement, and the Company shall have no exclusivity or sole-provider obligation to HDI.
